'''Personal Customer Identification Numbers''' were used by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] to organize their large number of patrons. Customers ordering through [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]] were required to provide their Personal Customer Identification Number when ordering products.
